name: Bathran's Hair
summary: At Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale, Orendil Broadleaf seeks Bathran's Hair for a sick child in Astranaar. He believes the illness afflicts the child's spirit, and sends you north to the ancient ruins where the uncommon restorative herb was gathered in the past.

sections.title: An Ailment of the Spirit
sections.body: Orendil Broadleaf, a night elf herbalist at Maestra's Post, faces a troubling illness. The post lies just south of the Darkshore border. A young child in Astranaar is grievously ill, and ordinary remedies have failed. Orendil believes the sickness afflicts the child's spirit as well as the flesh. He seeks Bathran's Hair, an uncommon restorative herb gathered in the ancient elven ruins to the north.

sections.title: Trespassers in the Ruins
sections.body: Bathran's Haunt lies along the eastern side of the road leading into Darkshore. Forsaken agents have infiltrated the ruined enclave, making the search for bundled herbs hazardous. When the plants return to Maestra's Post, Orendil brews a soothing draught. The undead operating openly in northern Ashenvale leave him deeply unsettled.

faq.answer: Bathran's Hair is an uncommon medicinal plant native to Bathran's Haunt in Ashenvale. Night elf herbalists value its restorative qualities, especially its power to soothe ailments of the spirit rather than ordinary physical wounds.

faq.q: Who is sick at Maestra's Post?
faq.answer: No one at Maestra's Post is sick. Relara Whitemoon, a young night elf child in Astranaar, is ill; she is the daughter of Pelturas Whitemoon. Her condition worsens by the hour, and ordinary remedies have failed because the sickness appears spiritual, prompting Orendil Broadleaf to seek ancient botanical aid.
Bathran's Haunt lies in northwestern Ashenvale, north of Maestra's Post and just east of the main road leading toward the Darkshore border. Hostile Forsaken operatives have overrun the ruins.

faq.q: Why are there Forsaken at Bathran's Haunt?
faq.answer: No one knows what the Forsaken are after. Orendil learns of them only when the herbs return, and undead lurking so deep in night elf lands trouble him greatly.

faq.q: What happens after collecting the plant?
aliases: what does orendil do with the hair
faq.answer: After you bring him five bundles of Bathran's Hair, Orendil prepares a medicinal concoction and asks you to hurry it to the ailing child in Astranaar. This begins the follow-up called Orendil's Cure.

faq.q: Can herbalists find the plant bundles easier?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundles lie scattered on the ground and can be hard to spot with the naked eye. Adventurers trained in Herbalism can detect them with their herb tracking ability.

angles.text: Herbalism tracking can reveal the bundles scattered throughout Bathran's Haunt, making the search among the ruins far easier.
As a night elf, you face the Forsaken presence at Bathran's Haunt, a grave threat to northern Ashenvale's sanctified borders and its children.
As an Alliance member, you help secure medicine for the child in Astranaar and support the frontline settlements holding western Ashenvale against hostile Horde and Forsaken expansion.
